title: A Page at Rest / 머무는 페이지 · runtime derivative

derivative.geometry_policy: All evaluated source triangles for sculpture and one context book; no simplification or lossy geometry compression. Source cyclorama, lights, camera excluded.
derivative.materials: Five opaque core metallic/roughness PBR defaults; procedural source shaders not baked or reproduced.

paper_runtime_shader.method: Godot opaque BACKLIGHT approximation plus restrained procedural colour grain
paper_runtime_shader.shadow_policy: Viewer disables shadow casting on the two paper meshes to avoid observed self-shadow banding; this is a documented transmission-shadow approximation, not physical light transport.

generated_reference_policy: Original concept and C2PA unchanged in original artwork. No generated-reference pixels included in the GLB.

validation.runtime_boundary: Proof ends at actual GLB bytes. Godot import, shader look and native keyboard QA are separate.

tooling_lineage.exporter: Adapted from the existing original projects/second-cup-viewer/export_from_blender.py geometry-audit workflow; retargeted to Page at Rest objects and material contract.
tooling_lineage.shader: Original procedural colour-grain shader using Godot BACKLIGHT; not a copy of the generated concept or Cycles surface pixels.
